**Average House Price in California (2024)**  
- **Median Home Value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000  
- **Mean (average) Home Value:** ≈ $850 000–$900 000  

> *Sources:* Zillow Home Value Index (ZVI), California Association of Realtors, and recent U.S. Census data.  
> *Note:* Prices vary widely by region—San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles are well above the state average, while rural counties are below.
